scope: Next incremental candidate after the frozen Gemma2 proxy candidate; no default/model/threshold change.

currentHost.command: Packaged runtime/node/node.exe or process.execPath in source mode.
currentHost.environment: Current allowlist inherits OS root, TEMP/TMP/PATH/PATHEXT/COMSPEC/CPU fields, plus HF and transformers offline flags.
currentHost.openLifecycle: Supported legacy factory still direct-spawns; Gemma2 becoming default would not waive it.

reusable: Same fixed generic flush helper/held-image lease, strict wrapper and private raw ownership/cleanup reader.
NDJSON op/requestId/role/texts/deadline remains byte-transparent. Legacy max16 texts, max262144 line bytes and current server max1s admission remain unchanged.
Worker already uses physical batch1, CPU2/1, its own locked model/pooling/prefix and implementation-derived model fingerprint. Do not replace it with Gemma2 output or namespace.
EOF stays cooperative normal shutdown; hard parent/helper death relies on the product Jobs and independent parent watcher, not that EOF.
necessaryDifferences: Use one process-private compiled generic proxy module and global unknown fence across legacy/Gemma2/model/config signatures; never a new factory fallback around an unknown owner.

Add fixed parent-side pins before executing legacy worker/protocol/verify and reading its lock inventories; worker self-verification alone occurs after its JS executes and cannot authenticate that earlier execution.
Keep the generic verifier builtin-only in the parent. Do not import Transformers or ORT into the main process.

Evaluate parent expected fingerprint against the exact child effective environment. verify.cjs reads process.env.RUYI_SEMANTIC_DISABLE_ARENA, but current host allowlist does not forward this flag; reusing verify directly in the parent could compute a different fingerprint. No global process.env mutation to emulate the child.

Replace caller-ambient OS executable/root/PATH with the reviewed canonical OS platform; sanitize rather than forwarding NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH/PSModulePath/COMPLUS. Record this as a new execution profile rather than claiming identical environment.
Move worker/bootstrap cwd and HOME to an exclusive marker-owned writable runtime home. Existing base cwd may be a read-only install path. Model/runtime roots remain absolute argv paths.

Choose runtime-home placement in the trusted host layer, outside the encrypted WorkData snapshot tree: resident child metadata IO must not alter the root atime/authority during crypto migration. Do not introduce pure-core back edges to boot/config/paths.
Treat every pre-spawn return/failure/cancel with observed lease release before home removal; unknown retains both records and a process-wide fence.
Missing helper/source/runtime/model gives the selected provider unavailable diagnostics and base lexical behavior; do not silently direct-spawn as a topology fallback.

sourceCompatibilityReasoning.cwd: worker resolves model/runtime/implementation files using explicit root or __dirname; tokenizer modelDir is absolute, FS caches are disabled. A private cwd is plausible, but must receive an actual parity and installed-readonly test.
sourceCompatibilityReasoning.protocol: Raw proxy cap524288 exceeds legacy262144 input line cap; parent current max32768 chars remains bounded. Existing large-tail primitive is not a full legacy numerical proof.
sourceCompatibilityReasoning.pooling: Preserve each locked model's mean/CLS, dimensions, role prefix and maxTokens; never mix384/512/768 vectors or caches.
sourceCompatibilityReasoning.features: No new routing, model discovery, quality point, fallback ranking or acceptance data is authorized by this assessment.

requiredTests: Native-free: legacy current protocol/byte pins, separate namespace, canonical env, private-home scope/deletion, callback primary errors, no spawn on missing/bad metadata.

Global fence: previously active plain legacy provider cannot encode/prepare after another client unknown; in-flight successful result becomes unavailable; config/factory/direct fallback remains blocked.
Exact same-worker numerical/token parity on consumed public/development inputs only, after root execution freeze; no threshold or model change.
Actual supported legacy shared startup/publicwarm/idle/session reuse, disable/reenable/shutdown, parent/helper hard exit and same OS identity absence under the new profile.
Read-only install plus trusted writable home, both-model combined resource scope if models can overlap, cross-Windows and full3.1 remaining gates.
notClosed: Lease/observer transient bootstrap parent-death gap still needs an independent watcher/Job solution and separate root-approved native contract.
Nested restriction runtime, generic proxy actual model connection and fresh installed-package resource/performance qualifications remain open.
